baseline.public: Current live Fingal content asserts that hot springs book out weeks ahead in summer and instructs visitors to reserve at least three weeks ahead for weekends. The current published hero is an uncredited CMS upload that labels the image only as Fingal.
baseline.independentSubset: Prior independent place reviewer scored Fingal 16/31 across VT2, FN1, ET3, VS1, VS2, VS3, MI1; this is neither a complete 23-criterion grade nor a 100-point score.
baseline.hardGates: The fixed three-week booking claim lacks operator support. The CMS hero lacks item-level attribution and rights evidence. Full 23-criterion visual, accessibility, field performance, mobile and factual checks remain open.

hypothesis: Replacing the arbitrary lead time with the operator's current booking advice reduces false urgency and lets visitors plan around real availability.
boundedChange: Correct only Fingal's worstTime and insiderNote fields. Retain the hero pending a separately reviewed locality-accurate, rights-clear, visually suitable replacement.
metric: Built and public Fingal guide contains no three-week or weeks-ahead booking assertion, communicates the operator's ahead-of-time and same-day surcharge advice, and retains an honest null full score. Build, browser and exact live checks must pass.
rollback: Revert the two content-field edits if current operator guidance or a browser/live journey contradicts them.
